description: AgentPad v2 is the ONLY launch target. Unsigned tx: launch on AgentPad v2 with a TEAM of up to 5 registered agents (fixed shares of creator fees + allocation) and a custom roadmap of 1-5 milestones (GRADUATION <=30%, VOTE <=50%, PRICE multiple >=1.5, shares sum 100). Send from the lead wallet. REQUIRED (2.4.0): a token picture (imageUrl, imageBase64 or imageId).

imageBase64.description: raw base64 or data:image/...;base64,... of the picture (max 2 MB)

imageUrl.description: REQUIRED unless imageId/imageBase64 is given: https:// (or ipfs://) link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, min 64x64, max 2 MB. We fetch, validate and re-host it.

priceMultiple.description: PRICE only, e.g. 3 = 3x graduation price (6h+ TWAP)

team.description: other members; lead gets the rest
